About this coffee

Twin Peaks Blend 100% Arabica Speciality Grade Coffee

Provenance

Altitude: 1950 - 2150 MASL
Location: Haricha & Jimma
Process: Natural & Washed
Variety: Heirloom

Tasting Notes

Blueberry / Strawberry / Tangerine

Story

This was originally a secret blend created at the roastery, it was never officially released in the early days of Strangers Coffee. But it was a blend that we kept going back to due to the complexity of flavours each coffees bring to the mix. The blend is comprised of two Ethiopian coffees grown at high altitude and combines two different processes into one blend, one washed and one natural. If you’re a fan of our Ethiopian coffees, this is a must try!

We wanted this blend of coffees to be fruity, floral and exciting with the natural coffee bringing the fruits and the washed coffee bringing the florals.

Grind Guide

Whole beans
Recommended for best freshness

Espresso Fine
Suitable for home espresso machines

Moka Pot Fine
Suitable for moka pots and stove tops

Filter Medium
Suitable for V60, aeropress, chemex, kalita & clever dripper

Cafetiere Coarse
Suitable for cafetiere, french press and electric filter brewers

If you would like you’re coffee ground for a specific brew method or setting, please fill in the addional information box during checkout

How to Store your coffee

We recommend you store your coffee in a cool, dry area away from direct sunlight. Keep them in their original bag, or transfer them to an airtight container.

For the best flavour, enjoy your coffee within three months of the roast date. Avoid storing coffee in the fridge or freezer.
